data.name: The Depths That Call
data.detailed_description:
In this dark fantasy first person shooter/slasher, you are a battle mage on a mission to retrieve an ally gone rogue.  With steel and spellcraft, descend into a mysterious subterranean city consumed by an unknown corruption. Unleash devastating power and uncover the fate of a fallen empire while an unseen force closes in around you.

UNLEASH AN ARCANE ARSENAL: Command destructive magic to annihilate your enemies and bend the world to your will. Incinerate foes, pull enemies from the sky, and distort time with power from the void as you descend into the depths.  

DEADLY ENEMIES: Face off against hostile mages, corrupted arcane war engines, and alien predators. All the while, keep a watchful eye on the air for circling threats preparing to rain deadly magic down on you.

MELEE CARNAGE: Tear through enemies with your blade and paint the walls with their ichor. Use your sword to reflect enemy spells back where they came from.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR BUILD: Read lost tomes. find corrupted altars, and equip cursed relics to unlock build-defining spells and abilities.

EMBRACE THE DARKNESS: Trade safety and sanity for power through forbidden magic that warps the world around you.  

CREEPING DREAD: Uncover the fate of a fallen empire devoured by an unknown corruption.

No AI generated assets, either raw or edited, are used in the game or marketing materials.

data.short_description: Wield spell and steel in this brutal, dark fantasy FPS set deep beneath a city consumed by a mysterious corruption. Master dangerous powers, obliterate your enemies, and face what waits in the shadows.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2550K or AMD FX-8370
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760, 2 GB or AMD Radeon HD 7870, 2 GB or Intel Arc A380, 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB, or Intel Arc A750, 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Significant violence and gore against humanoid enemies. Spells and melee attacks splatter ichor into the air and on nearby surfaces. Player can pick up, throw, and explode dead humanoid enemies.
